rationale: Price is at 99.9% of today's range, essentially at the session high of $889.00, after recovering from a deep intraday low of $836.24 — a massive $52+ range already consumed. Entering long at the top of a 6.3% intraday recovery with only 236 minutes remaining and a spread of 10.3 bps offers poor risk/reward, as the natural resistance at today's high and prior close ($895.08) is only $6 away while the stop would need to be placed well below current price to avoid noise. A short at exhaustion is tempting given the extended run-up, but the positive earnings beat catalyst and strong momentum in the last 5 candles argue against fading it; the setup lacks a clean asymmetric entry in either direction.
